name: Etsy API
description: Base integration that exposes the Etsy v3 API to Drupal as a service wrapper, authenticating a single Etsy shop over OAuth2 (via the oauth2_client module). Does nothing user-facing by itself.
library_dependencies: league/oauth2-client (provided transitively by drupal/oauth2_client; used by the Etsy OAuth2 provider)
project_description: Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods, with millions of shops. This module was designed to let shop owners integrate a single Etsy shop with their Drupal site. The suite was rewritten from the ground up for Drupal 9/10/11 using v3 of the Etsy API and ships two main modules: Etsy API (this base module) and Etsy Shop. Other modules are encouraged to require either or both as a dependency to implement the shop features a site needs. The Etsy API module provides a service wrapper (the etsy.api service) around the Etsy API and is designed to integrate a single Etsy shop; authentication with the Etsy API is delegated to the OAuth2 Client module. No ecommerce/checkout capabilities are contained in the module, to comply with the Etsy API terms of service. The term 'Etsy' is a trademark of Etsy, Inc.; this module uses the Etsy API but is not endorsed or certified by Etsy.
